title: [LT-102367] Event detail - Collect Attendance action - Opens participant bulk attendance dialog
description: AC 01.1-01.2 - Scenario - Activity Event detail exposes Collect Attendance and opens the bulk dialog with loaded participants.
preconditions:
- Logged in to BO Calendar as HQ or CM Staff with Activity Event detail access.
- Activity Event EVT-102367-A is visible on Calendar and has at least 3 Event Participants.
- Event Participant section is loaded in the Activity Event detail drawer.
steps_actions:
1. Open Activity Event EVT-102367-A from Calendar.
2. Locate the Event Participant section.
3. Click Collect Attendance.
4. Count participant rows in the dialog.
steps_result:
1. Activity Event detail drawer opens.
2. Event Participant section displays participant count and action menu.
3. DialogCollectAttendanceEventParticipant opens.
4. Dialog shows all loaded Event Participants from the detail section.
steps_data:
1. event = EVT-102367-A
2. participants >= 3
3. action = Collect Attendance
4. expected rows = loaded participants

title: [LT-102367] Event attendance - Single participant Attend - Save updates status and clears note
description: AC 01.3, AC 01.5, AC 01.7, AC 03.1-03.2 - State Transition - Attend can be selected and saved, and Attend clears the participant attendance note.
preconditions:
- Activity Event EVT-102367-B has Participant A with Attendance Status blank and Attendance Note blank.
- Activity Event EVT-102367-B has Participant B with existing Attendance Status = Absent and Attendance Note = Needs follow-up.
steps_actions:
1. Open Collect Attendance for EVT-102367-B.
2. Select Attend for Participant A.
3. Select Attend for Participant B.
4. Click Save.
5. Refresh Activity Event detail and inspect Participants A and B.
steps_result:
1. Participant A and Participant B are listed.
2. Participant A row shows Attend selected without opening the remark dialog.
3. Participant B row changes to Attend and its note becomes empty in the dialog.
4. Save succeeds, dialog closes, and success snackbar is shown.
5. Both participants show Attend; Participant B attendance note is empty.
steps_data:
1. event = EVT-102367-B
2. status = Attend
3. previous note = Needs follow-up
4. expected snackbar = Attendance marked successfully
5. expected API fields = Attendance_Status__c Attend; Attendance_Note__c empty

steps_data:
1. event = EVT-102367-C
2. status = Absent
3. remark = Sick leave
4. expected payload row = Id + Absent + Sick leave
5. expected readback = Absent / Sick leave
